edges.reason: claim() safe-mints to the caller controlled _msgSender(), so an attacker contract receives execution during the mint loop.
The _safeMint receiver hook onERC721Received is invoked inside claim()'s loop before all bookkeeping completes.
addTitle() authorization depends entirely on _msgSender() equalling ownerOf(tokenId).
withdraw() sends the whole balance to msg.sender, gated only by the onlyOwner modifier.
hash() seeds the pseudo random traits with block.timestamp, allowing miner timestamp manipulation of minted rarity.
nonce is packed into the seed string passed to random() inside hash().
claim() calls hash() to derive the trait string for each minted id.
ownerClaim() calls hash() for the reserved id.
hash() delegates the weighted selection to random().
random() consumes its string parameter via keccak256(abi.encodePacked(input)).
getHeadscape() reads tokenIdToHash to slice out each trait index.
tokenURI() consumes the parsed Headscape struct.
tokenURI() calls generateSvg() to build the image payload.
generateSvg() includes the filter block produced by getFilter().
claim() writes the derived hash into tokenIdToHash for each minted id.
hash() consults hashToMinted to reject duplicate trait combinations.
addTitle() writes titleToIsTaken to lock the keccak256(abi.encodePacked(text)) key.
addTitle() reads and writes tokenIdToTitle for the given token.
The num parameter bounds and drives the claim() mint loop.
numClaimed is passed as the tokenId seed into hash() and refreshed from totalSupply().
tokenId selects the token to look up and title in addTitle().
text is validated, cleaned and persisted as the on-chain title.
tokenId selects the reserved id to mint in ownerClaim().
tokenId selects the token whose metadata is rendered by tokenURI().
claim() transfers half of msg.value to the hard coded EFF address.
withdraw() forwards the entire contract balance to the caller.
hash() returns the built trait string h.
h is persisted into tokenIdToHash by claim() and ownerClaim().
The caller address becomes the _safeMint recipient, which is what triggers the external receiver hook.
getHeadscape() materialises the Headscape struct local variable.
The parsed Headscape struct flows into generateSvg().
claim() increments nonce after every mint to vary subsequent hashes.
ownerClaim() safe-mints to owner() and therefore also triggers the receiver hook.
